title: 🌀 Pseudo-3D Spaces

accepted_baseline.label: Five-scene monumental Spaces engine
preserve: Map 5 orange ritual sky and straight longitudinal road stripes

current_candidate.summary: Spaces v23 replaces Map 5 pointed violet spires with alternating violet abyss-columns rising from below the road. Columns are near-black at the bottom and progressively lighter toward the top. The lateral floor is removed so the avenue reads as a bridge over a precipice. Giant hinged cardboard screens are larger again, hinge from inside/behind each column, stay fully hidden during the first/last part of the animation, and a hard two-slot scheduler guarantees no more than two signs can be visible/opening at once.

open_feedback: Review Map 5 columns: they should read as monumental columns rising from a dark precipice, not as pillars sitting on a floor.
Review vertical shading: column bottoms should be markedly darker and tops clearly lighter without becoming neon.
Review screen concealment: no cardboard/pole should be visible while it is stored or disappearing behind a column.
Review sign scale: screens are intentionally larger than v22 but should still leave enough road visible.
Verify that no more than two signs are ever visibly deployed at once.
